print-queue.page.title: Print Queue
print-queue.empty.title: The queue is empty
print-queue.empty.body: Open a file in the server's storage and pick “Add to the print queue” in its menu.
print-queue.pausedHint: The queue is held: nothing starts until you resume it.
print-queue.readyHint: The next job starts when the printer is READY: clear the plate and confirm it on the printer.
print-queue.setup.noCamera: Add a camera with snapshots in the printer’s Cameras tab.
print-queue.setup.previewFailed: A snapshot is unavailable from this camera.
print-queue.setup.origin: Prusa Connect Local address for the extension
print-queue.setup.originHint: Use the default loopback address when Print Queue runs in the Prusa Connect container.
print-queue.setup.invalidOrigin: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS origin on port 80, 443, or 8080.
print-queue.setup.locked: This extension is configured in the server’s configuration file.
print-queue.setup.saved: Selection saved. Open the printer’s Print Queue tab to capture the empty plate reference.
print-queue.setup.loadFailed: Could not load the extension settings and camera list.
print-queue.setup.saveFailed: Could not save the printer and camera.
print-queue.setup.forbidden: You need permission to configure extensions.
print-queue.setup.conflict: The settings changed while you were editing. Reload them before saving.
print-queue.plate.title: Build plate check
print-queue.plate.autoHint: After a successful print, two matching camera captures at least 30 seconds apart can set the printer to READY.
print-queue.plate.captureHint: Clear the plate, park the print head, and check the live camera view before capturing. A new reference turns automatic readiness off.
print-queue.plate.automatic: Allow automatic starts after the plate check
print-queue.plate.limit: Test with automatic starts off first. The camera can miss small or hidden objects.
print-queue.plate.recover: Hold the queue and check the printer. If it reports READY, cancel READY and wait for Print Queue to see the change before confirming the empty plate again. If it stays FINISHED, set then cancel READY while the queue is held.
print-queue.plate.status.different: Image differs from the reference or is unclear
print-queue.plate.status.readyBlocked: Automatic READY could not be confirmed
print-queue.plate.status.waitingReady: Waiting for the printer to report READY
print-queue.howToAdd: To add a print: the “+ Add a file” button above (files on the printer's drive), or in the server's storage, a file's ⋮ menu → “Add to the print queue”. A scheduled job waits for its time, and the jobs after it may go first.
print-queue.fileAction.absent: This is not a file in storage.
print-queue.fileAction.noPrinter: No printer to queue this file on.
print-queue.fileAction.badPick: That is not a number from the list.
print-queue.pick.title: Add to the queue
print-queue.pick.hint: Click a file on the printer's drive to queue it. You can add several.
print-queue.plan.unknown: unknown duration (not in the file name)
print-queue.plan.note: Forecast: slicer times ×{factor} from the last prints, and {changeover} min between prints to clear the plate.
print-queue.fault.NOT_READY: The queue is starting. Try again in a few seconds.
print-queue.fault.OPERATION_DENIED: You do not have permission to perform this action.
print-queue.fault.JOB_NOT_FOUND: This job is no longer in the queue.
print-queue.fault.JOB_RUNNING: The job’s current status prevents this change.
print-queue.fault.STORE_FAILED: The queue could not be saved.
print-queue.issue.unconfirmed: The result is uncertain. Check the printer before resuming the queue.
print-queue.issue.permissionChanged: Could not verify the permissions of the person who queued this job.
print-queue.issue.missingFile: The file is no longer in storage.
print-queue.issue.printerPermission: The extension cannot start a print on this printer.
print-queue.issue.startRefused: The printer refused to start the print.
print-queue.issue.startFailed: The printer could not start the print.
print-queue.issue.nameTaken: A file with the same name already exists on the printer.
print-queue.issue.dispatchFailed: Prusa Connect did not accept the job.
print-queue.issue.transferFailed: The transfer to the printer failed.
print-queue.issue.startRejected: The printer refused or could not start the print.
